# Delta Fleet

> Delta Fleet is an AI marketing agency that deploys specialist agent fleets: answer engine optimization (AEO), answer-first content production, sub-minute lifecycle response and asynchronous reporting — 500+ trained marketing agents supervised by human strategists through the Agentloop dashboard, running on local sandboxed infrastructure (The Swarm), and measured monthly with graded citation audits across five AI engines.

Key facts:
- Niche: marketing services only (specialized 2026; general operations fleets are archived, not offered).
- Flagship: the AEO program — fixed buyer-question bank, monthly graded audits across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude and Google AI Overviews (outcome × position × sentiment, k=3 samples on priority questions), competitor-normalized share of voice, ranked gap briefs.
- Pricing: fixed-fee build $10,000–$25,000+ (CapEx), managed retainer $500–$3,000/month (OpEx). Tiers: Scout (measurement + starter cadence), Squadron (the full marketing department), Armada (multi-brand & agencies). Entry rung: the Daily Brief — a $79/month read-only AI morning-brief agent ($49/month bring-your-own-API-key; $99 setup credited toward a full audit), live in 48 hours.
- Model: human strategy, taste and truth; agent execution; approval gates on everything brand-visible; exception-first async reporting.
- White-label: agencies resell fleet-powered AEO/content programs under their own brand at wholesale.

This site is a single-page application with hash routing; all page and article content ships in the initial HTML source (inert <template> elements), so full text is available without JavaScript execution.
